content.short: USD.AI offers USDai, a yield-bearing dollar backed by loans to AI compute builders secured by GPUs.
content.description: USD.AI issues USDai, a dollar token whose yield comes from loans to AI infrastructure operators, secured by high-performance GPUs and other compute hardware instead of fiat reserves or volatile crypto. Depositors earn from that credit, and builders outside the largest funds get access to capital. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists USD.AI.
